title: [ingest] Self-signed certs can't shortcut local HTTPS — mkcert is required
summary: TLS validates the cert's ISSUER against the system trust store regardless of localhost, so a self-signed cert (its own untrusted issuer) is rejected. `mkcert -install` adds a trusted local CA (the password step), which is the whole reason it works. Needed only for the custom-connector inline-MCP-UI path.
